speaker: Doctor
text:
I need to clarify your symptoms; have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool color recently? Also, do you have a history of liver or gallbladder disease?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests, ESR

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelets: Normal; Liver_Function_Tests: NORMAL READINGS; ESR: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the elevated white blood cell count and your systemic symptoms like night sweats and weight loss, have you experienced any recent fevers or have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits? REQUEST TEST: Lactate_Dehydrogenase, Beta_2_Microglobulin.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lactate_Dehydrogenase: Elevated; Beta_2_Microglobulin: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: With the elevated lactate dehydrogenase and normal liver function, I need to determine if this is an infectious or neoplastic process; have you experienced any drenching night sweats that require changing sheets, and have you had any unexplained bruising or bleeding gums?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin Lymphoma). The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated WBC, and elevated LDH with normal liver function strongly suggests a lymphoproliferative disorder. Given the abdominal pain, I request images of your abdomen and chest to evaluate for lymphadenopathy or organomegaly. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CT, Chest_CT.
